title: sprite.ts: DepthState does not track scaleX/scaleY/rotation — Move tag not emitted for transform-only tweens
description:
In encodeDefineSprite() (packages/swf/src/sprite.ts), the DepthState interface (line 183) only stores { objId, x, y }. The posChanged check at line 225 only compares x/y/objId. If a motion tween changes only scaleX, scaleY, or rotation without changing x/y (e.g., a scale-in or spin animation), posChanged evaluates to false and no PlaceObject2 Move tag is emitted. The symbol plays back without the scale/rotation animation.

compile.ts's equivalent DepthState (line 927) tracks scaleX, scaleY, rotation, skewX, skewY, ratio, and colorEffectKey in addition to x/y. sprite.ts needs to be updated to match.

Fix: add scaleX, scaleY, rotation, skewX, skewY to sprite.ts's DepthState interface and posChanged comparison. Also pass scaleX/scaleY/rotation/skewX/skewY from the (interpolated) display object to the PlaceObject2/Move encoder.
